summary: Comprehensive Security, Performance, and Code Quality Audit Report & Prioritized Implementation Plan for KÜLV. Evaluates current system metrics (174 passing tests, 72.3% statement coverage, strict CSP, rate-limited OpenWeather proxy, R-Tree spatial indexing), identifies critical gaps (missing package-lock.json for automated CVE auditing, low coverage in syncQueue and store state reducers, unmemoized solar shadow geometry on high entity counts), and details an actionable 4-phase hardening roadmap.
